name: WiFi Password Napkin
pickup_text: The barista drops it like it means nothing. It means everything.
flavor_text: A damp paper relic containing the one credential standing between you and productivity.
rules_text: Counts as a key item for any encounter gated by local WiFi access. Consumed if the venue changes the password.

name: Transit Card with Suspiciously Specific Balance
pickup_text: You find it under a communal couch next to a charging brick and a moral compromise.
flavor_text: Somebody absolutely meant to come back for this and absolutely never will.
rules_text: Can pay one transit fare or substitute for a small bribe in a hurry. Worth full value only to someone who uses the system.

name: VIP Wristband of Dubious Legitimacy
quest_hook: Get Past the Guest List Guardian
pickup_text: It still smells like perfume, panic, and a decision somebody regrets.
flavor_text: A flimsy fabric halo granting temporary access to rooms full of terrible people and useful information.
rules_text: Gain +2 Access in nightlife scenes until security notices you or the wristband gets wet and starts disintegrating.

name: Blocked Number
pickup_text: Your phone becomes lighter by one emotional liability.
flavor_text: A contact entry that now exists only as a warning to future you.
rules_text: Gain advantage on one save against Ghosted, Charmed, or Uncomfortable from the same source.

name: Leftover Fries of Unclear Ownership
pickup_text: They are cold, salty, and somehow still therapeutic.
flavor_text: A paper cone of fries nobody admits ordering.
rules_text: Restore 1d4 Chill during a short rest if eaten before anyone asks whose they are.

name: Patagonia Fleece of Borrowed Authority
pickup_text: It smells like seed funding and airport lounges.
flavor_text: A quarter-zip that makes mediocre opinions sound investable.
rules_text: Gain +1 Access in startup, VC, or conference scenes; lose the bonus if Fact Checked in public.

name: Failed Startup Stickers
pickup_text: Every sticker once believed it was changing the world.
flavor_text: A sheet of abandoned brand marks from companies that pivoted into silence.
rules_text: Spend one sticker to gain +1 on a tech bluff, then explain what the company did and take 1 cringe damage.

name: Expired Coupon of Moral Victory
pickup_text: It expired six months ago, but the argument is fresh.
flavor_text: A coupon whose fine print has become a battlefield.
rules_text: Spend to distract a Karen-like enemy for 1 round if you can keep a straight face.

name: Oversized Sunglasses of Managerial Distance
pickup_text: The lenses say 'I will not be perceived at this volume.'
flavor_text: Sunglasses large enough to hide either tears or contempt.
rules_text: Gain +1 Cringe Resistance against public scrutiny in retail or travel scenes.

name: Receipt for the Last Outlet
pickup_text: Possession is nine-tenths of socket law.
flavor_text: A receipt proving you bought one coffee and therefore deserve electricity.
rules_text: Counts as leverage when contesting outlet access in cafes or coworking spaces.

name: Emergency Power Token
pickup_text: A tiny claim on continued civilization.
flavor_text: A laminated token exchangeable for ten sacred minutes near an outlet.
rules_text: Spend to ignore Power Loss for one scene or trade for +1 Access with a tech-dependent NPC.

name: Number With Actual Authority
pickup_text: It is not the main number, which is how you know it works.
flavor_text: A phone number written in blue pen under three layers of unofficial protocol.
rules_text: Once per campaign, reroll a failed bureaucracy or visa check after escalating politely.

name: Laminated Stamp of Maybe
pickup_text: It is not official, but it is official-adjacent in a way that scares interns.
flavor_text: A stamp that says enough without saying anything legally binding.
rules_text: Gain +2 on one Access check involving paperwork; on a natural 1, gain Heat +1.

name: Muted Thread
pickup_text: Peace arrives as a tiny crossed-out bell.
flavor_text: A group chat that can no longer bite your ankle every thirty seconds.
rules_text: Remove Distracted from one digital scene; the thread may still mutate offscreen.

name: Context Screenshot
pickup_text: The rarest treasure: the message before the screenshot.
flavor_text: A screenshot with enough surrounding context to ruin a bad-faith narrative.
rules_text: Spend as Receipts Collected or to remove Misinformation from one claim.

name: Fair Bill Receipt
pickup_text: Everyone paid exactly what they owed. The table is briefly socialist.
flavor_text: A receipt annotated with calm math and no emotional debris.
rules_text: Reduce Heat by 1 after a food or brunch scene if the party avoided public accounting violence.

name: Brunch Coupon of Conditional Forgiveness
pickup_text: Good for one mimosa and a silence nobody should break.
flavor_text: A coupon for a future meal under terms nobody fully trusts.
rules_text: Restore 1d6 Chill if used during downtime with someone you annoyed last session.

name: Usable Golden Hour
pickup_text: For twelve minutes, nobody's pores are anybody's business.
flavor_text: A fleeting stretch of perfect light that forgives bad decisions.
rules_text: Gain advantage on one creator, glamour, or first-impression check before the light changes.

name: Sponsor DM
pickup_text: It begins with 'love your vibe' and ends near taxes.
flavor_text: A private message from a brand that may or may not pay in money.
rules_text: Convert into +1 Access with creator factions or a low-value cash reward during downtime.

name: Version-Controlled Pitch Deck
pickup_text: Finally, one deck, one truth, one font family.
flavor_text: A pitch deck with a commit history and fewer lies than expected.
rules_text: Gain +2 on one startup pitch or investor check; Fact Check attempts against the deck are made normally.

name: Investor Intro of Questionable Warmth
pickup_text: The email says 'happy to connect' with the enthusiasm of a closed elevator.
flavor_text: A warm intro that becomes colder each time it is forwarded.
rules_text: Spend for +2 Access to VC or founder NPCs; expires after one downtime cycle.

name: Barista Trust Token
pickup_text: Kyle nods once. It is basically knighthood.
flavor_text: A tiny social credit with someone who controls caffeine and seating.
rules_text: Spend to reduce cafe Heat by 1 or learn one local secret without buying another drink.

name: Plus-One Wristband of Plausible Invitation
pickup_text: The name on the list is not yours, but the font believes in you.
flavor_text: A wristband that gets you into events where nobody wants to admit they check lists.
rules_text: Gain +2 Access to one event scene; fails immediately if compared to the real guest list.

name: Bouquet of Plausible Denial
pickup_text: Flowers: nature's apology template.
flavor_text: A bouquet used to cover either romance, sabotage, or poor planning.
rules_text: Spend to reroll one failed apology or distraction check at an event.

name: Conference Room Keycard
pickup_text: It opens every room except the one where decisions are made.
flavor_text: A coworking keycard with just enough permissions to create trouble.
rules_text: Gain access to one restricted coworking zone; on a failed stealth check, Heat +1.

name: Union Slack Invite
pickup_text: The channel name is innocuous. The pinned posts are not.
flavor_text: An invite to the backchannel where the real tenant politics happen.
rules_text: Gain +1 Trust with coworking regulars or reveal one faction clock trigger.

name: Confiscated Phone Basket
pickup_text: A woven basket full of withdrawals and lock screens.
flavor_text: The retreat's phone basket, humming with unsent texts.
rules_text: Recover one lost device or trade it for leverage over the wellness staff.

name: Therapy Coupon That Expires Soon
pickup_text: It covers half a session and one whole admission that things got weird.
flavor_text: A coupon that is either a benefit or a cry for help.
rules_text: During downtime, remove Doubt or reduce Burnout recovery time by one scene.

name: Perfect Night Market Skewer
pickup_text: It arrives hot, smoky, and emotionally correct.
flavor_text: A skewer so balanced it briefly restores faith in street logistics.
rules_text: Restore 1d6 Chill or gain +1 CON saves for the next scene.

name: Auntie Vendor Blessing
pickup_text: She calls you too thin, then protects you like family.
flavor_text: A vendor's approval, delivered through criticism and extra sauce.
rules_text: Gain +2 Access or advantage on one market navigation/social check.

name: Stable Demo Recording
pickup_text: The demo worked once. That is enough for marketing.
flavor_text: A screen recording of the only successful run.
rules_text: Cancel one failed live-demo consequence by showing proof that reality briefly cooperated.

name: Postmortem Template With Blameless Blame
pickup_text: It says 'process gap' where a name clearly belongs.
flavor_text: A polished incident template with tasteful ambiguity.
rules_text: Reduce Heat by 1 after a tech failure if the party admits just enough fault.

name: Gate Change Push Alert
pickup_text: The notification arrives before the panic, which is growth.
flavor_text: A screenshot of the gate change nobody else saw.
rules_text: Act before the airport crowd in one transit scene or avoid Surprised.

name: Priority Boarding Apology
pickup_text: The airline cannot fix your life, but it can board you in Group 2.
flavor_text: A voucher that proves somebody somewhere acknowledged inconvenience.
rules_text: Gain +2 Access in airport or transit scenes; expires after one trip.
